snippet.title: Magic Kingdom // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700120/Magic_Kingdom/

Self moving chess, RTS, Meat pigeon game. In the game, you will control the hero, lead a powerful army, release powerful magic, have a strong city defense, and coordinate resource collection to resist the enemy's strong attack

Developed by 
Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
